prompt: I'm about to reuse this checkout form schema in a new flow — can you sanity-check it first?

assertions.text: Flags the .refine() callback calling throw new Error(...) instead of returning false, noting refine() should return a boolean, not throw
Flags the hand-written `interface CheckoutForm` duplicating the schema shape and recommends deriving the type via z.infer<typeof CheckoutFormSchema> instead
Flags `email: z.string()` missing .email() validation, noting it currently accepts any non-empty string as a valid email
